history.summary: Normanton Park (D05, 2023, 99LH) unit at $1.5M / $1,908 psf for 786 sqft — the listing title is contradictory (calls it a 3-bed penthouse but the data says 786 sqft 2BR), so the actual format needs verification. Large 1,800+ unit One-North-adjacent mega-development with strong rental fundamentals but a recent surge of resale supply hitting the market.
history.rating_rationale: Normanton Park is a ~1,862-unit 99LH mega-project near One-North/Kent Ridge with deep liquidity and tenant demand, but it completed in 2023 with heavy concurrent resale/sub-sale supply that pressures near-term exit pricing. At $1,908 psf for a compact 786 sqft 2BR the $1.5M quantum is liquid, yet the misleading title (3-bed penthouse vs 786 sqft 2BR) is a red flag to verify, and no URA rate is matched. Solid hold-for-rental candidate, limited near-term appreciation edge given supply overhang.
